/* Parametric last relations (men), generated by AO_Biomech.ipynb on 2026-10-11
/* Source: ANSUR II male, n = 4082, OLS regressions on foot length. Units: mm
/* INPUTS from family table (do not assign here):
/*   FOOT_LENGTH  real, mm
/*   WIDTH_GRADE  integer, 1 = B narrow, 2 = D medium, 3 = 2E wide

/* allowance: extra length past the longest toe (measured on 5 shoes, notebook Section 4)
TOE_ALLOWANCE = 18.0

/* allowance: last ball girth minus foot ball girth (not measured; 0 = snug fit)
GIRTH_EASE = 0.0

/* allowance: last bottom width / foot width (measured on 5 shoes, notebook Section 4)
BOTTOM_WIDTH_FACTOR = 0.97

/* allowance: heel-to-toe drop (measured on 5 shoes, notebook Section 4)
HEEL_HEIGHT = 8.0

/* allowance: toe lift off the ground plane (measured on 5 shoes, notebook Section 4)
TOE_SPRING = 42.1

/* ball girth change per width grade (girth residual tertiles)
GIRTH_STEP = 9.8

/* ball width change per width grade (same split)
WIDTH_STEP = 3.5

/* heel to toe tip of the last
LAST_LENGTH = FOOT_LENGTH + TOE_ALLOWANCE

/* heel to ball station, R^2 = 0.856
BALL_LENGTH = 0.7393*FOOT_LENGTH + 0.46

/* ball girth target, R^2 = 0.357 before grading
BALL_GIRTH = 0.5895*FOOT_LENGTH + 92.15 + (WIDTH_GRADE - 2)*GIRTH_STEP + GIRTH_EASE

/* max width at the ball, R^2 = 0.347 before grading
BALL_WIDTH = 0.2352*FOOT_LENGTH + 38.09 + (WIDTH_GRADE - 2)*WIDTH_STEP

/* last bottom width at the ball
BOTTOM_BALL_WIDTH = BALL_WIDTH*BOTTOM_WIDTH_FACTOR

/* heel breadth, R^2 = 0.234
HEEL_WIDTH = 0.2019*FOOT_LENGTH + 17.74

/* last bottom width at the heel
BOTTOM_HEEL_WIDTH = HEEL_WIDTH*BOTTOM_WIDTH_FACTOR

/* heel-ankle girth target, R^2 = 0.63
HEEL_ANKLE_GIRTH = 1.0067*FOOT_LENGTH + 70.49
